Interview Text:
Abdisa Duguma Interview (part 13)

I wanted to know more about what Jesus was like in his dream.
What did Jesus' voice sound like? 
Abdisa gets a big smile
I don't have a word. Sweet.

But he was commanding you. How could it be sweet? 
Yes . . . 
Abdisa continues to smile deeply. 
The voice comes from Love. Every time I hear his voice it comes from love.
